meta.description: Your leases, contracts and invoices, read and checked by Orazaka: every finding quotes its rule and the line it rests on, every PDF examined for signs of editing, every document found again in a second.

chrome.footer: Yomizaka is a Krizaka product — made in Montréal, open source (Apache-2.0).

landing.title: Read before you sign.
landing.lead: Drop a lease, a contract, an invoice. Orazaka reads it against the Civil Code of Québec, examines the PDF for signs of editing, and shows you every line it relies on — never a verdict out of nowhere.

facts.runs: Every check is a traced Orazaka run

landing.reasonsTitle: Three traps it takes off your desk

check.title: The clause you skimmed
check.trap: A security deposit, postdated cheques, “no children” — written in, forbidden by the Civil Code, signed anyway.

tamper.title: The PDF that was edited
tamper.trap: An invoice re-saved after it was issued, its producer not the one you expected.

find.title: The document you cannot find
find.trap: The clause is somewhere, in one of forty PDFs, in a folder you no longer open.

landing.decisionsTitle: What we chose, and what it costs you

rules.chose: Rules that cite their source, in force on the date you pick.
rules.refused: A model's opinion of your lease.
rules.because: A finding you forward to a landlord must quote the law and the line it rests on.
rules.cost: Québec first (rules to be reviewed by a lawyer), France and Wallonia next; a jurisdiction arrives as a ruleset, not as a guess.

signals.chose: Signals with three plain levels — observed, unusual, inconsistent.
signals.because: A percentage without a measured base rate is a lie that gets quoted in a dispute.
signals.cost: You get the questions to ask, not a conclusion to hide behind.

engine.chose: Every analysis is an Orazaka run, its id kept with the result.
engine.refused: A model called straight from the app.
engine.because: What ran, on which version of the rules, can always be traced and replayed.
engine.cost: Analyses wait for Orazaka: seconds, sometimes a minute.

landing.promise: I read every line and I quote it. I never tell you a document is genuine or fake — I show you what deserves a question.

how.title: Three steps, one trace
how.lead: Nothing is analysed by Yomizaka itself: it keeps your documents, and Orazaka does the reading.

keep.title: 1 · Keep
keep.text: Drop PDFs or text files into your library. The file is kept as you sent it, its text layer read for search.

check.title: 2 · Check
check.text: Ask Orazaka: a lease against the rules of its jurisdiction, a PDF for signs of editing. The run id stays with the result.

find.title: 3 · Find
find.text: Search every document and every finding at once — the passage comes back with the words in bold.

check.title: Two checks, both run by Orazaka
check.lead: Each finding gives its rule, the article it rests on and the exact passage of your document. What the text cannot settle is said so.

landing.closingBody: Yomizaka is in development: sign-up is closed. Tell us what you need to read — leases, supplier invoices, a Law 25 inventory.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Yomizaka is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. A document you upload is kept in Yomizaka's database (Toronto, Canada), visible to your account alone. When you ask for a check, the document — its text, or the PDF file — is sent to Orazaka, Krizaka's analysis engine, over HTTPS, and the result is kept with the run's id. Nothing is sold, shared or used to train a model. Deleting a document deletes its file, its text and its analyses. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.
